description: Moonee Valley - Drinking Fountain is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Moonee Valley City Council. This data-set provides location details of Drinking fountains in Moonee Valley City council. Though all due care is taken to ensure published data is accurate and error free, Moonee Valley City Council does not warrant the accuracy or completeness of information in this publication. Coverage: Moonee Valley City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Moonee Valley City Council. Its tags are Drinking Water, Drinking-water, Location, Society, Utilities and Communication. It offers 4 resource(s) in esri shapefile - zipped, geojson, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
